sources.sections_read: Object Messaging; Message Syntax; Polymorphism; Dynamic Binding.
sources.confirmed: Objective-C incorporates all keyword segments and colons into a method's selector name, independently of parameter and return types. Message dispatch can vary both receiver and selector.

sources.title: Objective-C compound selector literals and SEL values
sources.sections_read: SEL and @selector; Methods and Selectors; Varying the Message at Runtime; Target-Action; Avoiding Messaging Errors; dated footer.
sources.confirmed: A selector literal names all keyword components without argument values and yields a SEL that can be passed separately from a target object. The document distinguishes a method name from a concrete implementation and discusses runtime receiver validation.
sources.limits: A SEL identifies a method name rather than a bound implementation or a typed function value; a transfer must define receiver binding and retain static signature checks separately. This is the recorded read scope, not a full-document or deployment validation. Evidence time class: pre_decision. Original read and any failures remain in runs/A/C27.json.

sources.title: Scala named-argument placeholder anonymous functions
sources.version_or_date: Live SID-1 documentation describing Scala 2.8; no page publication date established
sources.sections_read: Named Arguments; Functional values; Overriding; Overloading Resolution.
sources.confirmed: The Scala design uses parameter names when determining applicable overloads and describes how static receiver types determine accepted parameter names. The examples also show ambiguity can remain after named-argument filtering.
sources.limits: The examples still require an expected function type or an explicit placeholder type, and the opened documentation does not establish support for overloads distinguished only by labels; that capability would need separate language rules. This is the recorded read scope, not a full-document or deployment validation. Evidence time class: unknown. Original read and any failures remain in runs/A/C27.json.

sources.limits: Arity does not distinguish methods with equal argument counts and different labels, so this mechanism would need a richer identity component to meet the central requirement.
